vulnerability.explanation: In the Expose case, sx/sy are set to dx+xOffset/dy+yOffset, while w/h are set to MIN(event->xexpose.width, iw) and MIN(event->xexpose.height, ih). When a fake Expose event is posted with width/height equal to the full image size (e.g., in ResizeProc at lines 1304-1309) and xOffset/yOffset > 0, this results in sx + w > image width (or sy + h > image height). The subsequent XPutImage call at line 1268 reads past the bounds of xImage->data, causing an out-of-bounds read and potential crash. This occurs when appData.usePixmap == False.
